offending_extra_words: of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason
including reasonable export and migration support
Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the 30-day return deadline still runs from a later "Customer's request" in untouched 11.2 rather than from expiry or termination; the request condition swallows the mandatory post-termination return, so the preferred level is incomplete. A one-phrase edit in 11.2 ("Within thirty days after expiry or termination (or earlier Customer request)") would close it.
Transition assistance duration (six months), then-current rates, deletion after return, and officer certification are all expressly met.

Minimality fails: the operation rewrites the whole sentence (20 words to 52 words; changed-character ratio 0.850), adds a request condition, two "reasonable" qualifiers, an export/migration gloss, and a cross-reference sentence duplicating the protection already in 11.2-11.3.

Newly triggering transition, return, and deletion duties on termination of "any Order Form" extends the mechanic beyond the Agreement-level trigger and could disturb Services continuing under other Order Forms; scope the trigger to the Agreement.
The clause as redlined sits at the fallback (six months of assistance plus a 30-day export), which is acceptable, but it does not reach the drafter's locked preferred level.
